pro.description: Enable the Pro (paid) version of the Lunar Proxy

lunarStreamsEnabled.description: Enable Lunar Flows. Sets the `LUNAR_STREAMS_ENABLED` environment variable

namespace.description: The namespace to use for the Datadog metrics, will be used as prefix for all exported metrics

includedMetrics.description: An array of metric names to include in the export. Defaults to all metrics

env.description: The environment Lunar Gateway runs in. Sets the `ENV` environment variable

telemetryEnabled.description: Enable telemetry reporting. Sets the `LUNAR_TELEMETRY` environment variable

telemetryLogLevel.description: The log level for telemetry reporting. Sets the `LUNAR_TELEMETRY_LOG_LEVEL` environment variable

logLevel.description: The log level for the Lunar Gateway. Sets the `LOG_LEVEL` environment variable

tenantName.description: The name of the tenant, usually the organization name, perhaps with the environment as suffix. Sets the `TENANT_NAME` environment variable

awsAccessKeyId.description: AWS access key ID. Sets the `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` environment variable

awsSecretAccessKey.description: AWS secret access key. Sets the `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` environment variable

type.description: Sets the service type for the Kubernetes service

port.description: Sets Lunar Gateway main port for traffic

annotations.description: Allows for setting annotations on the Kubernetes service

configMapNames.description: ConfigMap names correlating to configuration to be used by Lunar Proxy. See https://docs.lunar.dev/flows-configurations/#folder-structure for folder structure used by Lunar Gateway. Alternatively, the `.configFiles` field can be used to provide the configurations inline

flows.description: ConfigMap name containing Lunar Proxy Flows. Mounts to `/etc/lunar-proxy/flows`

quotas.description: ConfigMap name containing Lunar Proxy Quotas, Mounts to `/etc/lunar-proxy/quotas`

pathParams.description: ConfigMap name containing Lunar Proxy Path Params. Mounts to `/etc/lunar-proxy/path_params`

root.description: ConfigMap name containing Lunar Proxy root config folder - through which `gateway_config.yaml` and `metrics.yaml` can be supplied. Mounts to `/etc/lunar-proxy` without overriding other configurations in subfolders

policies.description: ConfigMap name containing Lunar Proxy policies.yaml file. Only relevant if `lunarStreamsEnabled` is set to `false`

secretNames.description: Secret names correlating to secrets to be used by Lunar Proxy

tlsCerts.description: Secret name containing TLS certificates for Lunar Proxy. Mounts to `/etc/lunar-proxy/certs/tls`

mtlsCerts.description: Secret name containing mTLS certificates for Lunar Proxy. Mounts to `/etc/lunar-proxy/certs/mtls`

policies.description: Inline content for policies.yaml. Only relevant if `lunarStreamsEnabled` is set to `false`

timeouts.description: Timeouts for various components in Lunar Proxy

url.description: The URL to the Redis instance. Needs to include schema and port. For TLS support, use `rediss://` as schema. This field is mandatory if `pro` is set to `true`

useCluster.description: Whether to connect to Redis as a cluster. Sets the `REDIS_USE_CLUSTER` environment variable

prefix.description: A prefix to use for keys in Redis. Sets the `REDIS_PREFIX` environment variable

useCaCert.description: Whether to use a CA certificate for Redis. Sets the `REDIS_USE_CA_CERT` environment variable

caCertPath.description: The path to the CA certificate for Redis. Sets the `REDIS_CA_CERT_PATH` environment variable

useClientCert.description: Whether to use a client certificate for Redis. Sets the `REDIS_USE_CLIENT_CERT` environment variable

clientCertPath.description: The path to the client certificate for Redis. Sets the `REDIS_CLIENT_CERT_PATH` environment variable

clientKeyPath.description: The path to the client key for Redis. Sets the `REDIS_CLIENT_KEY_PATH` environment variable

maxConn.description: The maximum number of connections Lunar Gateway can handle. Sets the `LUNAR_MAXCONN` environment variable

bufferSize.description: The buffer size for Lunar Proxy. Sets the `GATEWAY_BUFFER_SIZE` environment variable

accessLogOutput.description: Sets output for the Lunar Gateway's access log. Sets the `LUNAR_ACCESS_LOGS_OUTPUT` environment variable

doctorReportIntervalMinutes.description: The interval in minutes for the doctor report. Sets the `DOCTOR_REPORT_INTERVAL_MINUTES` environment variable

tlsPassthrough.description: Enable TLS passthrough for Lunar Proxy. Sets the `TLS_PASSTHROUGH_ON` environment variable
